description_for_human: Browse F1 race tickets, merchandise, the 2026 race calendar, and VIP experiences like paddock access and driver meet & greets.
description_for_model: Use this plugin to answer questions about the F1 Racing Store. Available tools: get_tickets (race tickets with pricing and availability, filter by race name or category like 'VIP Paddock'), get_merchandise (official team apparel, accessories, collectibles — filter by team like 'Ferrari' or 'Red Bull'), get_calendar (2026 F1 race schedule with circuits, dates, locations), get_experiences (VIP hospitality packages, pit lane walks, simulator sessions, driver meet & greets). All prices in USD. Always use live tool data — do not answer from memory.
